story.head: The Jets roll past the Canucks
paras: The first period was a wild one. Alex Iafallo and Cole Koepke scored just 14 seconds apart early in the period to put the Jets up 2-0. Liam Öhgren got the Canucks on the board less than three minutes later. Dawson Mercer scored his first goal for Winnipeg midway through the first to make it 3-1 for the Jets. Neal Pionk extended the lead to 4-1 early in the second. Mark Scheifele stretched the lead to 5-1 less than five minutes later, with Viggo Björck picking up his first NHL point on the goal. Mario Ferraro made it 6-1 midway through the third. Brock Boeser cut Winnipeg’s lead to 6-2 with just under five minutes left, far too late to matter.

The Jets drove the play, and the scoreboard caught up. Stuart Skinner made 24 saves for the Jets, and Leevi Meriläinen allowed six goals on 29 shots. Nobody on the ice had a bigger night than Dylan DeMelo, by our Swing measure. The Jets improved to 6-8-3, seventh in the Central, while the Canucks dropped to 3-14-1, still last in the NHL.

items.text: The Canucks are on a four-game losing streak.
The Jets have beaten the Canucks five straight times, going back to the 2024-25 season.
The Jets have won two of their last ten.
NHL.com had projected the Jets with 11 forwards and seven defensemen, but they dressed 12 and six.
